raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Stopping `EncoderScheduler` during same-turn image/audio coalescing can leave the first dequeued request unresolved. `_collect_batch()` has removed that request from the queue and yielded, but `_batch_worker()` has not yet received the returned batch. Its cancellation handler therefore sees an empty batch, and `stop()` can only reject requests still in the queue. The affected caller continues waiting until its request timeout.

## Modifications

- Dequeue the first request in `_batch_worker()` so its existing exception/cancellation cleanup owns the request before coalescing yields.
- Pass that request to `_collect_batch()`; retain the existing batch size and same-turn coalescing behavior.
- Add deterministic image/audio regression cases covering both the dequeued request and the still-queued request during `stop()`.

## Accuracy Tests

- WSL Ubuntu 24.04, Python 3.12.3: both new regression cases fail against the original runtime; the 14 existing cases pass.
- With the fix, all 16 cases pass using a local isolated-import harness. The harness imports the complete production `encoder/runtime.py`; it does not copy or replace scheduler methods. Model, transport, and observability import boundaries are doubled. Real asyncio tasks, queues, cancellation, and futures execute normally.
- Standard pytest collection was attempted but the full SGLang dependency environment is unavailable (the first missing import is NumPy; PyTorch, Triton, and Transformers are also absent). The isolated run is not a full-package or GPU/distributed integration test. Upstream CPU CI remains necessary.
- Ruff lint/format, isort, Python compilation, and `git diff --check` pass for the changed files.
- All applicable changed-file pre-commit hooks pass. The required `pre-commit run --all-files` was also attempted in an isolated checkout: Python lint/format, registered-test checks, codespell, and clang-format pass. Repository-wide Rust checks cannot run because `rustup`/`cargo` are unavailable; the initial pass also normalized unrelated existing EOFs and Windows symlink placeholders in the isolated copy. Those changes are excluded from this patch.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No GPU/model accuracy or serving-throughput benchmark was run. The change moves ownership of an already-dequeued request and does not add a wait or alter encoding behavior.

## Checklist

- [x] Run pre-commit for the changed files (all applicable hooks pass).
- [ ] All repository-wide pre-commit hooks pass (Rust tooling unavailable locally).
- [x] Add focused regression coverage in the existing CPU-registered test module.
- [x] Follow the existing code style.
- [ ] Full SGLang CPU CI (not available in this local environment).
- [ ] Model accuracy/speed benchmarks (not applicable to this shutdown fix).

AI assistance: Codex investigated the ownership gap, prepared the patch and tests, and ran the local checks. A separate Codex agent reviewed the change. Human maintainer review is still required before merge.

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("modality", ["image", "audio"])
+def test_stop_rejects_request_dequeued_before_coalescing(modality):
+    async def run_test():
+        scheduler = EncoderScheduler(
+            encoder=None,
+            send_sockets=[],
+            max_batch_size=8,
+            coalesce_same_turn=True,
+        )
+        requests = [_pending(modality) for _ in range(2)]
+        for request in requests:
+            await scheduler.pending_queue.put(request)
+
+        scheduler.start()
+        # The worker dequeues the first request, then yields to coalesce arrivals.
+        # Stop it before it can drain the second request or dispatch the batch.
+        await asyncio.sleep(0)
+        try:
+            assert scheduler.pending_queue.qsize() == 1
+        finally:
+            await scheduler.stop()
+
+        errors = [
+            request.future.exception() if request.future.done() else None
+            for request in requests
+        ]
+        assert all(isinstance(error, RuntimeError) for error in errors)
+        assert all(str(error) == "EncoderScheduler stopped" for error in errors)
+        assert scheduler.pending_queue.empty()
+
+    asyncio.run(run_test())
+
